name: Dan's Drive-In (Montpelier, ID) Classic Vanilla Soft-Serve Cake Cone
whyItWorks: A small cake cone carries a fraction of the dairy lactose found in a 24-oz thick milkshake, making it a safe, seed-free road trip sweet treat in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a small vanilla soft-serve in a plain wafer cake cone. Take a lactase enzyme tablet before consuming if lactose sensitive.
